profile.headline: Software Engineer at RelPro, Inc.
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary: Being a full stack developer with a consistently evolving skillset and deep-rooted knowledge, my ideal position within a company would be one that would allow me to increase my problem-solving skills and bring more challenges my way. What truly feeds the fire within me, is the never-ending pursuit of critically solving challenges with profound logic. Within my scope and approach, I am able to service companies in a way that simplifies the most complex of applications and/or products. With a background in data and data analytics, in a world where data is the new oil, I have confident absolution that I can help your company grow as your company helps me grow as well.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
• Optimize Google Ads campaign and Google Analytics report numbers to provide a weekly marketing report.
• Transfer data from MySQL to excel and develop graphs in order to draw insights to identify areas of improvement.
• Recreate their graph(s) to better visualize their web traffic numbers, clicks, cost, CTR, and sign ups.

positions.title: Shift Supervisor
positions.description:
• Successfully led and deployed a team of 6 baristas during peak hours the week of 2019 Thanksgiving resulting in a 2% sales increase. 
• Supervised the baristas and assisted in enhancing employee growth, morale, and teamwork.
• Collaborated with a manager to identify waste opportunities in store and developed inventory PARs resulting in a 5% decrease in food waste in Q2 2019. 
• Maintained a safe and hazard-less store based on the requirements of the company and the Department of Health. 
• Developed a positive relationship with my fellow shift team by listening, understanding and communicating any concerns and needs.

positions.title: Stock Associate
positions.description:
• Managed and answered inventory inquiries and provided service that reduced the average 4 min client wait time by 2 minutes.
• Assisted with processing and receiving 1000+ units  from UPS and FedEx on a daily basis, and ensured inventory was kept up-to-date.

positions.title: Field Researcher
positions.description:
• Managed communications with over 20 potential field researcher candidates to coordinate interviews for NYU Playlab.
• Assisted in facilitating workshops for families and managed inventory of over 200+ donations to ensure they reached families’’ homes. 
• Conducted home visits to analyze if low-income families benefited more or less from government assistance programs such as Parent-Child Home Program, speech therapy, occupational services, etc.
• Responsible for managing communication with parents in English and Spanish and ensured their information was up-to-date  to stay in contact for the research project.
